page.layout: One page of text, with two medallion portraits at the top (no text in them except the names GEDEON and ABIMELECH in the circle rims, which are part of the engravings and not transcribed as text). Running head at top centre above the text; page number top right. Full-width text below in paragraphs. Full-width small lines at the foot before the signature. No margin notes.

main_text.head: GEDEON, qui & Ierobaal, filius fuit Ioas, de tribu Manasse, iudicauit populum 40. annis, quorum primus, annus erat mundi 2699. ante Christum natum 1263.
main_text.p: Hic priusquam aduersus Madianitas contenderet, bis signum à Deo petiit, quò certior fieret se ab eo mitti. duobus itaque miraculis cõfirmatur: prius fuit in holocausto quod totum ignis absumpsit: posterius in vellere primùm humido, deinde ficco. Sic roborata fide, in prælium descendit, ac Oreb & Zeb, Madianitarum Duces, item Zebee (seu Zeba) & Zalmana, cæcidit, ac internitioni dedit, asserens in libertate Israëliticum populum, qui sub illorum iugum ante annos septem missus fuerat. Vide lib. Iudi. cap. 6. 7. & 9. & Iosephum lib. Antiq. 5. cap. 10.
main_text.head: ABIMELECH Gedeonis filius ex Droma concubina, septuaginta fratres suos, depto natu minimo, interfecit: populum administrauit ac iudicauit annos tres, quorum primus, annus erat mundi 2739. ante Christum natum 1223.
main_text.p: Hic vrbem Sichem expugnauit, incolas occidit, quorum vrbe diruit, ita vt sal in ea euersa spargeret. Ceterum turrim oppidi Thebes dum oppugnat, ostiumque exurere nititur, à muliere, quae illi fragmen molae in caput deiicit, opprimitur: & ne à foemina trucidatus dicatur, quendam ex suis militibus rogat vt gladio transfodiatur: quod & ille perficit. Sic miserè occumbit, qui fratrum suorum caede pollutus, tyrannide principatum arripuerat. Vide Iudi. 9. cap.
THOLA de tribu Issachar, iudicauit populum an. 23. post Abimelech. Iudicum cap. 10.
IAIR Galaadites populum iudicauit ann. 22. post ipsum Thola. Vide vt supra & Iose. lib. Anti. 5. ca. 12.

page.notes: Two engraved medallion portraits with the names GEDEON and ABIMELECH around the rims sit above the text; they are illustrations, not transcribed. Headings GEDEON and ABIMELECH are set in capitals with the first words spaced. The chronology lines ("annos", "mundi", "ante Christum") are run-in text in the body, so they were kept as part of the heading lines above. Faint foxing at edges; no doubtful readings.
